note: These entries are a static list that ships with the site. They describe changes to this prototype's content and are not a live feed; new entries appear only when the site is redeployed.

updates.title: Planetary Exploration section added
updates.summary: Seven mission-level cards for destinations beyond the Moon and Mars. They are kept separate from the equipment catalogue.

updates.title: Moon and Mars timelines and comparison added
updates.summary: Browse source-linked events by destination and compare equipment records side by side. Missing values are shown as unknown.

updates.title: Working equipment catalogue released as a prototype
updates.summary: The catalogue is a working subset of NASA Moon and Mars equipment records. It is not a complete inventory and several fields are still unverified.
